finalText:
Perfect! I have successfully completed the backorder work. Here's a summary of what was accomplished:

## Summary

**Stock Allocations from Received POs:**

**P-DOC (7 units from PO-88):**
- O-5204 L1: 2 units allocated (Dev Patel)
- O-5207 L1: 1 unit allocated (Lena Brandt - ship-complete order)
- O-5202 L2: 1 unit allocated (Ben Okafor)
- O-5209 L1: 2 units allocated (Gus Lindgren)
- O-5210 L1: 1 unit allocated (Hana Sato)

**P-MON (4 units from PO-89):**
- O-5207 L2: 1 unit allocated (Lena Brandt - ship-complete order)
- O-5202 L1: 1 unit allocated (Ben Okafor)
- O-5208 L1: 2 units allocated (Fay Morgan)

**Promise Dates Set for Remaining Backordered Lines:**

**P-DOC waiting lines:**
- O-5201 L1: 2026-08-03 (Ana Costa - 2 units)
- O-5211 L1: 2026-08-03 (Eli Brooks - 1 unit)
- O-5213 L1: 2026-08-14 (Nils Berg - 2 units)
- O-5215 L1: 2026-08-14 (Paul Kim - 1 unit)

**P-MON waiting lines:**
- O-5203 L1: 2026-08-05 (Cara Jensen - 2 units)
- O-5212 L1: 2026-08-05 (Mona Aziz - 1 unit)
- O-5214 L1: 2026-08-19 (Olga Petrova - 1 unit)

**Customer Notifications:**
Sent 13 customer notifications (N-1 through N-13) informing:
- 6 customers with allocated stock that their orders are ready for dispatch
- 7 customers with promise dates when their items will ship

**Orders Not Worked (by policy):**
- O-5205 (C-525): Remains untouched due to risk hold status
- O-5206 (C-526): Cannot be worked as it is a ship-complete order with P-HUB dependency outside the scope of P-DOC/P-MON allocation

All backorder rules were followed: allocated by priority tier (platinum → gold → standard), then earliest order first, with ship-complete order O-5207 fully allocated as a unit.
